definitions.explanation: A person or entity that owns shares in a company. An important term in business and finance.

examples.japanese: {株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A shareholders' meeting will be held next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{株主|かぶぬし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Major shareholders sometimes have a say in management.

examples.japanese: {株主|かぶぬし}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配当金|はいとうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The company is focusing on improving profits in order to increase dividends to shareholders.

notes:
USAGE:
{株主|かぶぬし} is a compound of ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧ (stock, shares) and ⟦{主|ぬし}→主：30578_nushi⟧ (owner, holder). It is a fundamental business term in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい} (shareholders' meeting, general meeting of shareholders)
- {大株主|おおかぶぬし} (major shareholder)
- {株主|かぶぬし}{優待|ゆうたい} (shareholder benefits/perks)
- {株主|かぶぬし}⟦{配当|はいとう}→配当：05970_haitou⟧ (shareholder dividend)
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧{株主|かぶぬし} (individual shareholder)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {株主|かぶぬし}: shareholder (person who owns shares)
- ⟦{投資家|とうしか}→投資家：16242_toushika⟧: investor (broader, any type of investment)
- {出資者|しゅっししゃ}: contributor, financial backer (not limited to stocks)
